returnInterest.note: Would love to see more of the country, although it's not the next thing on my list.

description.intro: Czechia is a Central European country known for its beer, historic cities, impressive architecture, and relatively affordable prices. I really enjoyed my time there, especially the cities, food, and atmosphere. It also left me wanting to return and explore more of the country's nature and countryside.
standouts: The historic cities were a highlight for me.
culturalNotes: Overall, I found people to be friendly.
personalNotes: I especially enjoyed the food, particularly the meat dishes.
The cities and architecture were amazing.
I wish I had spent more time exploring Czechia's countryside.

travelPracticalities.visaNotes: I did not need a visa.
paymentNotes: Both cards and cash are widely accepted.
transportNotes: The train network is quite extensive.
Several of my train journeys did experience delays.
languageNotes: The younger generation generally speaks good English.

notes: The weather was pleasant and neither too hot nor too cold.

foodNotes: I noticed that hearty meat dishes were quite common, which I liked.

regionsOverview.name: Prague
notes: It is one of my favorite cities in Europe.
